dedupe_keys.name: geoscience australia electricity infrastructure major power stations transmission substations and power lines of australia

description: Geoscience Australia's Electricity Infrastructure dataset gives the spatial locations of power lines, substations and major power stations in Australia, with lines as line features and substations and power stations as points. The data.gov.au entries read on 2026-09-26 offer a zip download of about 3 MB with a PDF metadata statement (entry modified 23 June 2026) and a separate National Electricity Infrastructure web feature service describing known major power stations, transmission substations and transmission lines (modified 18 June 2026). The candidate that led here was a copy of the power stations layer on an Opendatasoft demonstration portal, listing 569 stations and crediting Geoscience Australia. Files and the service are free; the data.gov.au entries do not specify a licence, and the services.ga.gov.au host refused automated requests on the day, so the WFS itself was not read. Caveats: coverage is limited to major assets and transmission, not distribution networks. Simulation uses are a national transmission topology for network flow studies and exposure of power stations and substations to bushfire, flood and cyclone hazards in resilience analysis. Related records: data-brisbane-city-plan-hv-infrastructure-overlay maps high voltage assets in Brisbane, and a Geoscience Australia liquid fuel facilities record, data-ga-national-liquid-fuel-facilities, is held on the integration branch.
licence: not stated (the data.gov.au entry says "License Not Specified")
